summary: Group hosts by location, like dc1 and dc2, and combine with function groups so you can update a whole datacenter one day and all app servers another.
questions: How do I group hosts by data center?
Can I combine function and location groups?

answer_card.title: Group hosts by location
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[dc1]
db01.test.example.com
app01.test.example.com

[dc2]
db02.test.example.com
```
Mix these with function groups, so you can target all nodes in one datacenter or all app servers anywhere.
